content: Reusable frpc service update workflow: 1) Pre-restart config validation via `sudo -u <service_user> frpc verify -c <config_path>` to catch TOML/parse errors, 2) Post-restart verification of `journalctl -u frpc.service --no-pager -n 30` for `start proxy success` logs instead of only checking service active status, 3) Confirm expected proxy ports are listening using `ss -tlnp | grep <port>`.
